scope: Castle Nathria (instance 1190). Equipment leaves with explicit item costs for 183888-183899 and permanent raid token sources. Fractional cost IDs retain the item creation context. Raid Finder, Normal, and Heroic share reward appearance sources. Mythic has a separate tint. Fated and other historical variants are outside this snapshot.
